purpose: Machine-readable county custodian routing and request tracking scaffold for Indiana official 2024 precinct/subcounty President and U.S. Senate follow-through.
sourceAuthorities: Indiana Election Division ENR JurR county jurisdiction JSON captures
Indiana Election Division statewide county precinct/split count PDF
routingPolicy: Ask the Indiana Election Division for a statewide machine-readable export first.
Use county rows only as custodian follow-up if the state confirms no statewide export exists.
Treat counties with at least 100 precincts or at least 30 precinct splits as high-volume/split follow-up priorities.
caveat: This is an operational request tracker only. It does not contain candidate result rows and does not replace official ENR county results or supplemental review caveats.
